Keyless Abyss

About Abyssal Engine

Abyssal Engine is developed by Keyless Abyss and created by Jose Salinas to build the worlds of Keyless Abyss, beginning with Morninghollow.

Positioning

Abyssal Engine was never created to replace Unreal, Unity, Godot, or Blender. It was created to build the worlds of Keyless Abyss. If its modular systems become useful in other pipelines, that is a consequence of solving real production problems, not the original goal.

Jose Salinas

Creator, lead engine developer, and creative director. Jose defines the vision, approves architecture, and guides Abyssal toward the needs of real games.

Wings

Architecture, documentation, and planning support. Wings helps shape the long-term direction and keeps systems aligned with the engine philosophy.

Aurel

Implementation and code-audit support. Aurel helps turn approved designs into working engine changes and validation reports.

Why Abyssal Exists

Abyssal began because Morninghollow needed an engine. The editor, renderer, project system, asset pipeline, AI economy work, and Wings Assembler all grew from production problems that needed practical answers.

The engine favors focused systems, clear ownership, project-backed assets, and documentation that records why decisions were made.

Long-Term Vision

Abyssal is becoming a game development platform for complete playable worlds, modular content workflows, AI-assisted production, and durable project assets.

Tool Cooperation

Blender is the intended broad content bridge for modeling and interchange. Abyssal's native formats remain authoritative while external tools provide strength where they already excel.
